correctness.rationale: The proof uses only Vieta relations and the exact signs of the source coefficients. For b,u>0, C0 is strictly positive and C2 has the sign of 1-R0^2. This yields the complete root classification. The explicit rational witness has R0^2=29/30, C0=658, C1=-8013/100, C2=1/10 and positive discriminant; both positive roots reconstruct distinct positive five-component equilibria with negligible numerical residuals.

originality.rationale: Quadratic root classification and backward bifurcation are standard and are not claimed as new. The original content is source-specific: Lemma 3.1 contains mutually incompatible subthreshold multiplicity statements, and the correction gives the exact discriminant classification plus an admissible parameter witness realizing two distinct endemic equilibria. Exact DOI/title/correction and semantic searches found no indexed repair of this lemma.
residual_risks: A non-indexed author note may have acknowledged the contradictory bullet.
The finding does not determine the stability of the two subthreshold endemic equilibria, so it does not by itself prove a full bistability interval.
The explicit witness is not epidemiologically calibrated.

value.rationale: The equilibrium multiplicity is central to whether a subthreshold vector-borne infection can coexist with the disease-free state and to the interpretation of the paper's backward-bifurcation section. Replacing the contradictory lemma with an exact discriminant classification identifies the saddle-node surface and prevents a one-equilibrium conclusion that is algebraically impossible; the explicit witness shows the issue occurs inside the stated positive parameter domain.
